name: KNEXTEC LLC
old_description: KNEXTEC is a wire harness manufacture and custom cable manufacture located in Las Vegas Nevada
about:
KNEXTEC LLC was founded in 2010 by Wayne Shafer in Las Vegas, Nevada. Virginia Shafer joined as co-founder, and the company established its manufacturing headquarters in Las Vegas with a second production site in Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico.

The company specializes in custom cable assembly and wire harness manufacturing, including design, prototyping, and low-volume production. Its capabilities extend to PCB rework and product upgrades, LED assembly, wire cutting and crimping, heat-shrink cutting, control panel manufacturing, and full box-build services. All products undergo 100% individual testing to IPC-A-610, IPC-7711/7721, and IPC/WHMA-A-620 Revision C standards.

KNEXTEC serves original equipment manufacturers in the gaming industry through its GamingCables.com division, as well as broader contract electronic manufacturing clients requiring high-reliability cable and harness solutions. The company emphasizes fast turnaround on exacting, short-timeline projects regardless of order size.

The founders built the business around a relationship-first philosophy, prioritizing responsive service and quality over project volume. This approach is reflected in their commitment to immediate replacement or repair of any non-conforming product and support for product development and design.
